source.prototype_scope: Optional session-owned per-RHS canonical projection guesses for iterative two-intercept-FE PPML; saved-FE and incompatible/dynamic routes decline. No tolerance, model, sample, rank, omission, separation or solver-family policy change.

memory_contract.layout: G = 8*(q*W + W + (W-1) + 2*q) + 512; L = sizeof(AtomicUsize)*q*W; admit 2G+L last
memory_contract.ledger: Sparse per-component/RHS counters stored in q*W bounded slots; no N-row bank. Actual capacity must not exceed requested optional allocation; moved bank must fit G.
memory_contract.lifetime: Old guess G + new metadata <=G + ledger L; base builder owns fresh right/scales. After finish old owner/ledger drop, new right/scales move into staged guess. Errors and rollback drop stage; inference drops retained bank.
memory_contract.allowances: Existing installation ordering, selected route/inventories, canonical builder allowance and dynamic solver execution allowance unchanged. Plan solver workspace grows only by 2G+L.

solver_contract.identities: Sample, topology, row count, eliminated effect, connected-component anchors and exact generated-column order must match. Weight-dependent geometry and current original inputs are always rebuilt.
solver_contract.normalization: Use the original new cold RHS maximum and norm; explicitly form b_new-A_new*guess. The warm residual never becomes the reference norm.
solver_contract.tolerance: Unchanged reduced CG target from config.tolerance*0.01 and original RHS norm; independent original-input certificate and canonical finite-rank authority remain required.
solver_contract.budget: For each component/RHS M=min(config.max_iterations,component_dimension). Warm attempt receives floor(M/2); cold retry receives only M minus all attempted iterations. The ledger persists through a late certificate retry.
solver_contract.failure: Nonfinite/incompatible optional conversion declines. A nonimproving explicit residual declines before iteration and preserves all M cold iterations. Late numerical certificate failure permits one fresh cold rebuild with the same ledger; fatal Allocation/Break errors propagate. Failed staging, rollback and inference handoff clear the bank.
solver_contract.limitation: Shared finite warm/cold work caps cannot guarantee identical fallback outcomes for every input. Any protected-decision difference rejects discovery; no benchmark-specific fence is allowed.

generator.order: for a in 0..64; for edge in 0..2; for repeat in 0..4, append one row in that order
generator.rng: none; all constants are exact dyadic values

near_roundoff_reproducer.row_hash_encoding: row-major [a,b,response,x0,x1,r,c,old_weight,new_weight], each value IEEE754 binary64 big-endian; no header
near_roundoff_reproducer.independent_witness: Within-response equals r and first within-control equals c: their repeated dyadic contrasts sum to zero within every level of both partitions. Assertions keep the original absolute 1e-10 witness bound, along with independent original-input certificates.

discovery_protocol.stop: First scientific/protected-decision failure, failed fit or timeout stops and retains every attempted and unattempted slot; no retry. At panel end require an accepted compatible guess and lower aggregate native and RRUNTIME total cost.

trace_encoding: Structured trace lists use ordered_field_rows: each row starts with the index of its key schema, then exact original field values. All traces roundtrip; repeated summary timing/solver/memory bits are omitted only after equality with the retained full-wire matrix is checked.
